entries.70f8254608baebb5: It is promoting the Medium-Term Management Plan “GREENS SUSTAINABLE JOURNEY 2028,” and its basic policies are to accelerate store openings to capture demand, establish business models for leisure brands and roadside formats, and foster an organizational climate that invests in people and takes on the challenge of growth. Its revenue target for the fiscal year ending June 2028 is ¥60 billion. In the fiscal year ending June 2027, it plans to open a total of 5 new business locations, starting with the 2nd domestic store of Ascend Collection.
